7.10 J1939 specific functionality
The Dem module is capable to support J1939 networks. On these, it uses a J1939
specific DTC.
[SWS_Dem_00845]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈The J1939 support shall be available in case the configuration container DemGener-
alJ1939 (see DemGeneral) is present.⌋
Note: The Dem is designed to distinguish ’Service only DTCs’ and ’all other DTCs’
assigning DTCs to certain event memories. In order to work correctly, with the
J1939Dcm APIs ’Service only DTCs’ need to be assigned to the user defined memory.
All other DTCs need to be assigned to primary memory.
